items.title: Pay for professional cleaning of kitchen and bathroom
items.quote: Please pay this amount within 14 days of receiving this letter.
items.computation: This is a private letter from a letting company, not an administrative act, so the statutory 3-day delivery fiction of § 122 AO / VwZG does not apply; instead ordinary § 130 BGB rules apply, under which the period starts on the actual day of receipt. The letter itself carries no printed date and no postmark/delivery date is given anywhere in the text, so the start of the 14-day period cannot be established. Without a start date, the 14-day deadline (which, once a start date is known, would run under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB as a period in days and be pushed to the next business day under § 193 BGB if it fell on a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday) cannot be computed.

warnings: The letter has no document date and does not state when it was sent or delivered, so the 14-day payment deadline ("within 14 days of receiving this letter") cannot be computed exactly; the actual receipt date should be checked (e.g. via envelope postmark) to fix the real due date.

Double-check that the IBAN given (DE95 3705 0198 0005 5505 00, Musterbank AG) matches the landlord's/agency's known bank details before paying, as a general precaution against fraudulent payment instructions.

The letter links the return of the deposit to this payment ('Your deposit will be returned in full once the payment has arrived.'); under German tenancy law the landlord's deposit settlement/return obligation is independent of this cleaning claim and withholding it entirely pending payment may not be fully justified — the tenant may want to clarify or seek advice if the amount or the cleaning charge itself is disputed.
